name: Jiujiang Defu Technology Co., Limited
summary: Jiujiang Defu Technology Co., Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electrolytic copper foils in China and internationally. The company offers lithium copper foils, such as ordinary strength and medium intensity double-sided lithium battery, high strength double-sided lithium battery, ultra-high strength 60 double-sided battery, low elastic modulus double-sided lithium battery, high elongation double-sided lithium battery, and PCF porous copper foils, as well as double sided lithium battery copper foil with high elastic modulus, ACF atomized foil, and SCF foil.
